responsibility: Defines the public CHREC interface used by loop analyses to represent scalar evolution as polynomial chains of recurrences. It declares the folding, conversion, application, substitution, and observer APIs; provides inline predicates for generated sentinels, constants, affine forms, invariance, and containment; and supplies the canonical builder for POLYNOMIAL_CHREC nodes that scalar-evolution and data-reference code use throughout the tree optimizer.
same_name_distinction: Defines the public CHREC interface and key inline predicates/builders, declaring the recurrence-manipulation APIs that tree-chrec.cc implements for scalar-evolution clients.
